name: Betrayal at House on the Hill
description: Explore a haunted house room by room until the haunt starts and one of you turns traitor. Then it's traitor against heroes.

intro: **Built from the official 2nd edition rulebook** by Avalon Hill, from Wizards of the Coast's [rulebook PDF](https://media.wizards.com/2015/rules/betrayal_rules.pdf).
This is the rulebook only. The *Traitor's Tome* and *Secrets of Survival* haunt books are left out on purpose, so nobody learns a haunt's goals before it starts.
The text was transcribed from the PDF's pages. Tap any page image to see it as printed.
